summary: Solana Co filed a prospectus supplement (424B5) to register an at-the-market equity offering of up to $250 million of Class A common stock through sales agents Clear Street and Maxim Group. The filing increases the prior maximum from $92.8 million, under which $24.7 million had already been sold. Shares trade on Nasdaq under symbol HSDT; last sale on May 28, 2026, was $2.04. Sales will be made on a commercially reasonable efforts basis, with agent compensation up to 3.0% of gross proceeds. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation.
